text:
kat: quick heads-up — onboarding hit a packaging edge on the python sample. poetry add redwood-sdk[async] resolved to a wheel that doesn't contain the async module, so CI tests fail with ImportError.

kat: repro: ubuntu-latest, py3.11, `poetry add redwood-sdk[>=1.8,<1.9]` then run sample.

rachel: stacktrace?

kat: `ImportError: cannot import name 'AsyncClient' from 'redwood'`

omar: likely resolver picked a prebuilt wheel missing package_data for extras. pip install of the same wheel (or sdist) works. poetry sometimes prefers wheels and skips expanding extras.

omar: created DEVPY-523 to track — we should add a wheel-content validation CI job and a short README note recommending `pip install redwood-sdk[async]` or `pip install --no-binary :all: redwood-sdk[async]` as a workaround.

devx-bot: ticket DEVPY-523 created: validate wheel artifacts across python versions and document pip/poetry guidance.

kat: added tiny PR to the sample app to import fallback `from redwood import AsyncClient  # fallback for pip installs` and updated onboarding docs. will follow up in the ticket. :+1:
